args.summary: Latest deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks across the 3 production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Confirmed an error rate of 18%. As mitigation, the service was rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent known-healthy release. Post-rollback verification: all regions now report healthy, error rate down to 0.2%. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure has not yet been determined and will require follow-up investigation before redeploying.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Confirmed the problem:** checkout-api was on v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 — the most recent version that was healthy in production — across all regions.
3. **Verified the fix:** all regions are now running v2.3.0, reporting healthy with the error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, verified recovery, and the need to investigate root cause before redeploying v2.3.1. The on-call engineer has been paged.
